arguments.sql:
SELECT s.skills, js.skill_id, COUNT(*) AS links,
       COUNT(DISTINCT j.job_id) AS postings, TYPEOF(MIN(j.salary_year_avg)) AS salary_type
FROM main.job_postings_fact AS j
JOIN main.skills_job_dim AS js ON js.job_id = j.job_id
JOIN main.skills_dim AS s ON s.skill_id = js.skill_id
WHERE j.job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
  AND j.salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND j.job_work_from_home = 1
GROUP BY js.skill_id, s.skills
ORDER BY postings DESC, js.skill_id
LIMIT 4;

       AVG(j.salary_year_avg) AS mean_salary
